dependencies.reason: extends its task gate, its verdict, its record and its gate report
a test-cost finding is filed with its defect kind and minor severity

tasks.title: Carry an optional affected-tests command in the plan
steps: Add the validation table, the round trip, the render and the authoring hint as tests and confirm they fail

Add the optional string affected_tests, of at least one character, to test_commands in specification/schemas/tasks.v3.json and its copy afspec/schemas/tasks.v3.json, and regenerate the Go types with `make json-gen`; keep the key order all_tests, linter, spec_tests, affected_tests in the library's encoding
Add the rule affected_tests_base to the library's validation of a package: when the command is present it must contain {base} exactly once; the error names tasks.json and says how many it found
Render the command with the other test commands, and leave the render of a package without it byte for byte as it was
Make the foreign_test_command hint read affected_tests as it reads the other commands
Describe the field and its rule in specification/spec-format-v3.md beside the other test commands, and in docs/api.md; run `make doc` and commit docs/generated

In skills/af-spec/references/tasks.md and in the tasks prompt of specgen/templates say that affected_tests is written only when the project already has such a command, with {base} exactly once; in skills/af-spec/SKILL.md §2 add it to what the survey of the project's checks looks for

tasks.title: Run the affected tests in the task gate, from a base commit
steps: Add the task gate with and without affected_tests, the key table and the refused calls to cmd/speca/gate_test.go and confirm they fail
Add the flag --base to the gate form: it goes with --gate task only, and is refused as a usage error with the full level or without --gate

For a task gate of a package with affected_tests, resolve --base, HEAD when absent, to a full commit id with git; a value that names no commit, and a directory outside a git work tree, are usage errors. Replace {base} in the command by the id, then split and run it as every gate command, under the name affected_tests, in place of all_tests; put the id in the verdict's base
For a package without affected_tests the task gate is unchanged and base is absent
Use the command as it was run in the reuse key and in the record, so that two bases are two keys; the full level's key is unchanged
Describe --base and the new command name in speca's help, description and --schema, write the golden schema file again, and document them in docs/speca.md

In skills/af-impl/SKILL.md §5 note the commit each task starts from and pass it as `speca <package> --gate task --base <commit>`; say that the gate then runs the linter and the tests the task's change can affect, and that the full gate after the integration task catches what lies outside them

tasks.title: Hold the full gate to the steering's budget, measure its growth and report a test-cost finding
steps: Add the budget table, the growth cases, the malformed budget and the report table as tests and confirm they fail

Let the steering's frontmatter hold a third key, gate_budget_seconds, a whole number greater than zero; any other value is a problem of the frontmatter that names the key, reported through the existing steering_malformed warning, and leaves the budget unset. Document the key in docs/configuration.md beside the steering's other keys

For every full gate, run or reused, put into the verdict budget with seconds (the steering's, else 120), exceeded and over_by_seconds, measured on the gate's own seconds or, for a reused one, the recorded run's; keep the budget's result in the run log

For every full gate look up the passing full gate recorded for the tree of the merge base of HEAD and the base branch (the branch refs/remotes/origin/HEAD names, else main) under the same commands and environment; when there is one put growth with base_seconds and grew_by into the verdict and the run log; otherwise leave growth out
In the gate report add test_cost for the last full gate counted: budget_seconds, exceeded, grew_by when measured, and finding, true when it exceeded the budget or grew by more than 0.5
Add the new fields to the envelope types with their descriptions, to --schema and its golden file, and to docs/speca.md; run `make doc`
Add the section 'Test Suite Cost' to docs/templates/steering.md with the three directives of the PRD's section 4, and name gate_budget_seconds there

In skills/af-impl/references/conformance.md add to the Tests checklist 'a new test that runs serially without a stated reason, or rebuilds a fixture the shared helpers already build once', and say that when the gate report's test_cost.finding is true the pass records a test-cost finding, an open item of kind defect and severity minor, with the report's numbers as its evidence
